Harness plugin: shrink oversized Claude requests so they never fail with HTTP 413 request_too_large
# dsh-anthropic-request-size-guard
Stops this Claude error in DeepSeek Harness:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

**Cause.** The Anthropic Messages API rejects any request body over 32 MB.
DSH re-sends the whole co

nversation every turn, including every image in
history as base64. Long agent sessions that take scr

eenshots (Android/iOS
emulators, browsers) add about 1 MB per phone-sized PNG (about 1.33 MB once
en

coded), so after a few dozen screenshots every request fails and the session
is stuck. A real stuck
session had 34 screenshots at 1280×2856, for a 38 MB request.

**Fix.** This host plugin wraps `fetch` for `api.anthropic.com/v1/messages`
requests. A request unde

r the budget (default 30 MB) passes through
byte-identical. A request over the budget is shrunk, che

ault 30 MB) passes through
byte-identical. A request over the budget is shrunk, cheapest step first:

1. Re-encode large images as JPEG, starting at a 1568px long edge. Anthropic
downsamples to about th

at size anyway, so the model sees practically the
same image. It steps down (1280, 1024, 768, 512) o

nly if needed.
That real 38 MB request became 6.1 MB at the first step.
2. If that is still not enou

gh, replace the oldest images with a short text
placeholder, five at a time, until the request fits.

3. As a last resort, truncate the largest old text blocks (never the latest
message).

Every step is deterministic and cached by content hash, so the history re-sent
each turn stays byte-
identical and the prompt cache keeps hitting.
